summary.en: A neon frame runs round an empty place and closes; the page inside wakes from dark while its parts drop out of the air onto it, in turn or all at once.
summary.zh: 霓虹框从左缘两头奔画、圈出位置；框内页面由暗转亮，页面的部件从空中带影贴落，可以错峰也可以齐落（镜头绕页面弧线转）。

fits: A ceremony of arrival for one UI panel in a dark, neon passage: a feature area shown for the first time, or the opening of a night-toned section.
notFor: Light or calm films (the neon and the tunnel are loud); a panel the viewer must read in detail (it is shown slanted); more than one per film.

overlaps.note: split heads round one flat element; frame-forerun is the frame for a whole panel in 3D with a page dropping into it
a brand frame snaps into place on the beat; frame-forerun is the frame as a prelude to the page landing

intent.en: Give one panel a ceremony of arrival: the frame claims the place first, then the page wakes inside it and its parts are set down from the air, so the viewer sees the interface being placed, not appearing.
intent.zh: 给一块面板一场登场仪式：框先到、占住位置，页面在框里亮起，部件从空中带影贴落，观众看到的是界面被“安放”进去，而不是凭空出现。

content.en: One UI page as 4–16 crops with their page positions (or a neutral workbench), an optional 1440 × 840 base image, and the product name (en ≤ 12 chars, zh ≤ 6).
content.zh: 一页界面，切成 4–16 块带页面坐标的部件图（或用中性工作台），可选一张 1440 × 840 底图，加产品名（英文 ≤ 12 字符，中文 ≤ 6 字）。

fits.zh: 暗场霓虹段落里给一块 UI 面板的登场仪式：某个功能区第一次亮相，或夜色调段落的开场。

notFor.zh: 明亮或安静的片子（霓虹和隧道很吵）；要观众细读的面板（它是斜着展示的）；一支片里用两次以上。

pairs.note: after the page has landed, a low pass across its regions

en: Pick the landing rhythm by meaning: staggered parts (forerun) for a page being assembled, all parts on one frame (together) for one whole arrival; mixing them gets both rejected.
The floating shadow must be clearly visible; parts that drop without a felt shadow look like a plain fade.
Use one of the two modes per passage and at most once per film; the same frame language twice reads as repetition.
zh: 按意思选落法：错峰贴落（forerun）是页面被拼起来，同帧齐落（together）是整体一次登场；用混了两边都会被否。
悬空贴落的影子必须看得出；没有可感的影子就等于普通淡入。
同一段落两式只用一个，一支片最多一次；同一套框语言重复会读作重样。

upstream.name: 霓虹框先行
upstream.summary: 强透视直角霓虹框自左缘两头奔画先行成型，页面在框内由暗转亮，同时框内组件/文字从 3D 上空带同形软影错峰贴落、随页面点亮同步完成贴合，背景霓虹群（demo 为同形框纵深回声隧道）终段熄灭让位
upstream.use: 暗场品牌片里给 UI 面板做"登场仪式"（框先到、内容后落）；功能区首次亮相；霓虹/赛博调性的段落开场
upstream.energy: 中高（三层动作叠进，但都服务同一次登场）

upstream.name: 霓虹框环绕齐落
upstream.summary: 霓虹框先行描框后，镜头绕页面左→右弧线旋转，页面全部组件/文字**同帧**从空中往下贴合（同形软影同步收敛）——整体登场式的框内安放
upstream.use: 单页 UI 的一次性隆重登场（与巡礼/逐区亮相相对）；暗场霓虹调性段落的主视觉揭幕；neon-frame-forerun 的姊妹镜
upstream.energy: 中高（一次性的大动作，落定即静）
